features.label: Pdac approved l1845 and l1852
features.text: Knee orthosis, double upright, thigh and calf, with adjustable flexion and extension joint

features.label: Custom contoured stability
features.text: Constructed from a specialized cold-malleable aluminum that allows the rigid double upright frame to be manually shaped to match the exact curves of your leg, eliminating painful pressure points while providing unyielding ligament support

features.label: Innovative step through application
features.text: Engineered with a compact 14-inch profile that uniquely positions the rigid calf cuff behind your leg, making it incredibly easy to put on and take off while remaining discreet and exceptionally comfortable under your daily clothing

features.label: Precise range of motion control
features.text: Features an intuitive tool-free polycentric hinge system that lets you quickly and accurately set specific flexion and extension limits, safeguarding your healing joint from harmful overextension during physical therapy or sports

features.label: Enhanced patient compliance
features.text: The lightweight, low-profile nature of this brace encourages consistent daily wear, ensuring your knee remains protected against sudden twists and impacts throughout the entire recovery process

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our US-based brace specialists for personalized support

measurement: Measure your M/L (Medial/Lateral) knee caliper width and your thigh circumference 6 in. above the mid-patella. Available in Right and Left configurations from XS to 3XL to ensure a precise anatomical fit. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for more details.
